A '''thrust trace damper''' was a stealth device used to help conceal the presence of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] by capturing the exhaust gases from a ship, and waiting for them to cool before expelling them into space. The [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']] was equipped with thrust trace dampers that enabled it to pass unnoticed through [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] advanced detection systems.
